name: Late Longshot to Resolution
description: Research finding that failed its out-of-sample test — not a trading recommendation. Buys either outcome priced 0.10–0.20 within 24 hours of the scheduled end and holds to settlement, 2% of starting capital per trade. Record (Realistic, $1,000, docs/RESEARCH_PROTOCOL.md): Mar–Jul 2026 all positive (+8.0%, +3.5%, +19.5%, +41.8%, +7.0%), then the two pre-registered untouched months both negative (Feb −29.6%, Aug −4.0%). Four out-of-sample months pooled: +3.8%, 90% CI −9.9% to +19.0%. Five trades made nearly all of the gains. Kept as a worked example of a pattern that looked real for five months and was not.
